name: resources-sandbox-cpu-limits

controlConfigInputs.name: sandbox_cpu_limit_max
controlConfigInputs.description: Maximum CPU limit allowed for Agent Sandbox SandboxTemplate containers.

description: Checks that Agent Sandbox SandboxTemplate containers have CPU limits set and that they do not exceed the configured maximum.
remediation: Set spec.podTemplate.spec.containers[].resources.limits.cpu to a value within the configured ceiling.
